notes.title: Update 2025.07
Industrial War July Update
notes.notes:
The Industrial War was updated in July, with improvements in map dragging and computation speed, but it is still recommended that players try to operate in a 'paused' state. In addition, three new scripts have been added. Below, we will provide a detailed introduction to the new scripts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/1406d1c3f7b4b254a9f72253d5e7856c9c36efdd.png
Script 1: On the eve of the outbreak of World War I
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/47c6748bc77fcc282e37efcc09a138cd1bbf598f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/799595fdff55701de8007368f45a334ee9b9d624.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/1e744d7e0bc39bf2db547cfb20b8482ee256494e.png

There are several interesting countries in this script:
 [olist]
    Choose German Empire, and try the acid and cool of single pick.
    The Northern Warlords of Yuan Shikai were chosen to recover Outer Manchuria and Central Asia while Russia was busy with the European war.
    The Austria-Hungary is chosen as the largest mineral resources and agricultural area in Europe. Only by guarding against Russia, we can cultivate land with ease.
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/78ec6c87171afe720a0125ffd076f208296bbbc4.png
Script 2: Eastern Revolutionary Movement
The Europe of this script has just gone through World War I, Germany has been weakened, Austria Hungary has been dismembered, Poland has been restored, and Europe is in a calm state. At this time, in China, where warlords were numerous, a force established a revolutionary government in southern China, brewing the Northern Expedition.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/d56b061f9f170c940c54f685704d36bbed5b8085.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/2e5d8dfd3a39eeb7564d05ca00891462b5f25c40.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/5d8815788aa255b15995b68807066dce77205ff6.png
This army, although guided and supported by the Communist International, has complete autonomy. The generals under the banner are even more prominent anti Japanese generals who will dominate China in the future.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/11cca4369b17bfbe03e20029aa46d3c83349c312.png
Script 3: The outbreak of World War II
This play is the craziest time of the Fascist Axis powers, early 1940. Germany attacked Poland and occupied the entire Central Europe, with a population of 120 million. Japan captured Wuhan, China, and the War of Resistance entered a stalemate between the two sides.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/5d8815788aa255b15995b68807066dce77205ff6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/d92d8d8e497a24933c6eb96d567248e20ad866f0.jpg
At this moment, fascist Germany was at its peak, pondering whether France or the Soviet Union would be the next. At that time, Japan was already at the end of its tether, and China's strategic depth had held Japan back. It was stepping up preparations for Strategic material, and the main force was to defend the counter attack.

notes.title: Industrial War Version Update
notes.notes:
The main content of this update is as follows：

① Added 20 combat maps (landing battles, street battles, Great Plains battles, swamp battles, jungle battles, etc.)

② More than 30 new types of troops have been added (5 landing ships, 5 amphibious attacks, 4 combat submarines, 6 special combat weapons, and 5 defense fortresses)

③More than 100 new urban functional buildings have been added (residential, aesthetic, military, commercial buildings, financial, etc.)

④Added urban interior maps and animations (expanding urban area, increasing functional blocks, and completing industrial chains)

⑤ In combat mode, players can control and command their troops in real-time (similar to red alert)

⑥ Defense Command Mechanism. The attacking side must destroy the defending headquarters in order to win the war. Defense Command, select and deploy under the 'Defense Works' column.

⑦ Optimized operation and combat smoothness, but it is still recommended to pause before operating.

[hr] [/hr] 

Added 20 combat maps

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/0b1bf941c52b2536ef3e3e55be9a24aa84dcc59d.jpg
The combat map has various terrains, including roads, plains, jungles, sandy areas, lakes, rivers, streets and alleys, which restrict the passage of different arms. On the army side, the areas where tanks and artillery cannot pass are jungles, lakes, rivers, and streets. So in street battles and battles with more water bodies, infantry and armored vehicles have advantages.

More than 30 new combat arms have been added

We have added five new special land combat weapons, including tracked artillery with "heavy artillery", self-propelled rapid fire guns with "overwhelming mountains and seas", explosive armored vehicles with "deep into the enemy's formation and perish with the enemy", flamethrowers with "close combat", and assault tanks with "penetrating behind the enemy's lines".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/9bf5181b0279eb32406b25e20d5f094a51fa71e9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/e1ed4586a5c424470c6c717e6b7d470bc3681ad9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/ad5181bf99d6c467fa9464208bc091b6c7032447.png

Because of the new landing operations, landing ships and amphibious attack weapons are added: landing ships can operate on mudflat, and amphibians can land directly on shore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/264bc1fb26212fe445c03caba614aeb65be7b01b.png

Optimization of urban construction

More than 100 new urban functional buildings have been added (residential, aesthetic, military, commercial, financial, etc.), and urban interior maps and animations have been added (expanding urban area, increasing functional blocks, and completing industrial chains)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/3db139c6eae9efabbc00615eb2ceabcc6961f4ce.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/027e4eea94119594c1f2eb1a2e186fec005b618c.png

Real time operation in combat scenarios

In combat mode, players can control and command our troops in real-time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/e613424b2f18c4c320abcb1c21372a1632323a3b.png

Specific operations:

1.Click on the unit to select it, and then click on other places to complete the command.

2. Select and click again to issue a garrison command, only attacking enemies within range without moving.

3. After the command arrives at the destination, the unit defaults to a garrison state and only attacks enemies within range without moving.

4. In garrison mode, click once again to retrieve the garrison command and allow the troops to fight on their own.


Defender's heavy artillery base

The attacking side must destroy the defending headquarters in order to win the war. Defense Command, select and deploy under the 'Defense Works' column. There are a total of 5 types of command centers, namely:

1. Artillery base: requires [artillery, cement, steel, soldiers, engineers, and commanders]

2. Heavy artillery base (1-3 batteries): requires [naval guns, cement, steel, soldiers, engineers, and commanders]

3. Heavy mortar base (exclusive to the German army): [210 howitzer, cement, steel, soldiers, engineers and commanders]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/cfb4788b6a1b1d135cda2e762cd404dc212c09de.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/dc857b607eb051538eb1952c2206165d419171ca.png

Other optimizations

1. Optimization of urban tax and production operations, but it is recommended that players pause the game progress for a smoother operation experience during the operation.

2. Legion layout map, military strength in the appointment and removal of commanders column [detailed]

notes.title: Industrial War's Content Update
notes.notes:
This update mainly focuses on the combat mechanism, let's take a look ：

 ① Legion Honor Emblem Mechanism

Whenever we win a battle , the system will provide badges at levels 1-5 based on the comparison of enemy and enemy strength, battle damage rate, and individual kill rate. The badges are drawn based on the true history of World War II in various countries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/f882f9d07d39d6d9c7380517447d4010c5a67175.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/c3e3f0ccc60b437b9cc08a84b6f45c069d807153.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/2834ea0c44e1b64204a662df32a71b21c209613d.png

Each badge will add combat effectiveness to the troops, and each unit of a regiment, brigade, or division can continuously accumulate badges. As long as there is combat merit, they will be awarded. Let's look at a list of badges of major countries：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/f01ef3c229fb14627d1d6785d646c8541a9436d2.jpg

② Accumulated combat experience of generals and troops

Each general will accumulate experience in the combat, including six fields: infantry, artillery, tanks, armor, navy, and air force. In history, such as Guderian's armor strength, Nimitz's navy, Charles de Gaulle's tank division, and so on. Regardless of success or failure in a battle, we still can gain experience from the enemy and our participating troops. For example：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/de258d3fa13c874dba2ebca2ccfd70f72a1d9bef.jpg

Each unit can also gain combat experience from war, and with the accumulated experience of the group commander, after multiple battles, it can develop an elite unit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/5b2d16485a1a02195cb522b1274ea2a64543209b.png

③ General Rank Mechanism

Each country has its own military rank system, such as the five-star general of the United States, the field marshal and air force marshal of Britain, France, and Germany, the Japanese army general, sergeant, and so on. Military ranks need to be awarded based on their military achievements, which can increase the abilities of generals and the number of troops they lead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/f09cfc9eeae3ea417f7b1d257ef4a0b9278d2b80.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/ac56bb98e95ca821e3b46a67a66191f403520beb.jpg

④ The growth of armed strength

Training principle: Solid support, tempered into steel! Based on the above points ①, ②, and ③, after each battle, the troops and generals can gain experience and even badges, which means that the combat power of the troops is becoming stronger and stronger. As long as the combat readiness resources are sufficient, supplies will be automatically obtained after the war, and we can immediately fight again, each time with a higher chance of victory than the previous one. It can be said that it has become a strategy of conquering cities and territories, and gaining experience if defeated.

⑤ Understand enemy strength

Before planning to attack the enemy, first assess their strength from the following points:
Ⓐ A powerful country：The military equipment of the Soviet Union, Germany, and the United States is the most advanced, with the most complete range of branches. If you don't have the most elite troops, without heavy equipment, never touch them. (If the player had the strength of the Soviet Union and the United States in the beginning, it would be dull.) The navies of Britain, the United States, and Japan are very powerful, and they also need the strength to provoke. France and Italy  have comparable strength between navy and army, while the Japanese army can only bully Asian countries. As for other countries, it can be used to practice and earn experience.

Ⓑ Economic strength and strategic position：Click on the enemy city, as shown in the picture：

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/242e5256b5187c265ca30723d263871b46210150.png

National funds are money that an enemy country can use for war, originating from the taxes of each city within its territory. Without land, money naturally decreases. Every enemy army that goes to the battlefield must be deducted here. Those small countries can be consumed by combat, especially in naval battles.

The percentage of strategic position is the highest proportion of national funds invested in combat in the country. The coefficient of 1.6 is the maximum number of times the opponent will resist the invasion with their troops. This coefficient depends on whether the city originally belongs to its own country, such as the recovery of Lushun. In addition, there are transportation routes between the two sides. The more routes connecting the city, the more advantageous it is for our side. If it is an isolated city, it will be very low.

So unless you want to exhaust your computer, it's not advisable to put too many troops into a battle at once, because if we have more enemies, they will also increase in multiples, and the absolute number will increase. If we attack a city with a coefficient of 1.4, we will have 10 enemy units and 14 enemy units, and only four more units are needed to solve the problem. If we send 30 units, the enemy will receive 42 units, and an additional 12 units will be difficult to solve.

⑥ Techniques for arranging troops and formations

Ⓐ Offensive and defensive direction：First, clarify whether you are the attacking or defending side. For computers, the attacking forces will be distributed on the left side of the map, while the defending forces will be on the right side. And players are unrestricted and can be distributed incidentally. So some weaker long-range weapons can be arranged at a distance from the enemy. Some heavy or surprise troops can be placed directly in enemy positions to quickly defeat enemy long-range firepower points.

Ⓑ Fortification：If attacked by a computer, according to the above Ⓐ, the computer is the attacking party and its distribution location is on the left side of the map. Then look at how many "entry" paths are on the left side of the map, leave a section of the road for the enemy to be pulled into a "long snake formation", and deploy frontal firepower points in appropriate positions. The front firepower point, also known as the defense line, can have several more layers. Then the combat troops are behind the defense line. It is not ruled out that some computer raid troops will come to the rear, but it is a small number. Note that the more defensive fortifications there are, the better. The more fortifications there are, the more enemy troops there will be, so the key is to have a good location.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/73279ddfa618195797a3514b0d69c2d5361dbe10.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43776078/6f2522387f01b0df9b7ecf97642c1842bafb1e76.jpg 

The above is the main content of this update, while the rest is to address the issue of urban port entry and exit, optimize the interface to reduce tedious operations, and so on. The next update direction is as follows: 1. Deepen diplomatic operations; 2. Add distinctive combat maps; 3. Special urban interior design; Real time micro operations in battles, such as targeted bombing, on-site command, etc.

We hope players can provide more support and turn 'Industrial War' into a classic.
